prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design 在场 Today/scheduling page, landscape1536x1024. Entirely new dedicated scene: “before leaving, under a campus colonnade”. The same literary painted art universe, warm stone pillars, wood bench, open autumn air and gentle morning light, but no bedroom/window-seat cover. It should feel like considering the day before going outside. Natural plants are allowed, no green UI. Use navy/copper typography and quiet pale stone/cream writing surfaces.
A fixed horizontal top navigation 在场 聊天 今天 留下, 今天 selected, search/new/small Sakiko portrait. Main task is a genuinely usable day timeline, not a dashboard. Compose the timeline with its own calm broad full-height backing integrated into the architectural wall/notice desk; leave daylight and colonnade depth visible at the right edge. No gigantic date headline or artificial performance stats.
Representative synthetic day content: “10月26日 周一” with previous/next and a modest add action “记一件事”; timeline marks 09:00,10:00,11:00,12:00,13:00,14:00,15:00. Real event blocks accurately align:
09:00–10:30 “微分方程” secondary “东1 · 204”
11:00–11:45 “把第二个等号想清楚”
12:00–13:00 “午饭与留白”
14:00–15:30 “写完实验报告”
Do not fill every gap. The user's cursor has moved “把第二个等号想清楚” to 10:15. Show a quiet copper-outline ghost at 10:15–11:00 with actual overlap against the class and a brief local consequence “和微分方程重叠15分钟”. Original event remains distinguishable. Local buttons “放回原处” and “改到10:30” beside that ghost, not a big modal. A small linked source “刚才的那道题” stays with the study event and can resume it. One nearby small companion speech can say “课后那段还空着。” as example, not system-confirmed action.
Sakiko is the same character through a small approved portrait and a tiny simple cat on the timeline edge; do not add a giant full figure that competes with appointments. No circular progress meter, productivity score, daily completion list, irrelevant cards, explanatory headline, buttons strewn across landscape. The architecture and accurate temporal alignment create the layout. Actual text/page controls will be real components, no painted calendar as functional substitute. Preserve beautiful air, depth and calm while the day remains easily readable and editable.
